items.q: Who decides whether water already used is affected?
items.a: Your quality unit. Our signed service report gives it the facts: when readings left specification, where, what we found and what we did. We do not release water.

items.q: We have no service plan. Will you come?
items.a: Yes, inside [service coverage area], as a call-out with the next available technician, at [call-out and hourly rates, CAD].

todo: Service phone (FD-27): [service phone number] and [service phone hours], the names the nav and footer (CONTACT in core.js) and every other page use. Fill the hero's call link (secondary_cta, tel:) in the same commit; if the number is still open at launch, it goes with the urgent route (DR-008). Who answers out of hours and makes the triage call: service engineer, dispatcher or nobody; if nobody, route 2 and the phone menu say so, with the form note's [out-of-hours form review time, hours] (buyer panel 2026-10-31).

Severity 1 clocks (FD-27, FD-28): [severity 1 phone answer time, minutes], [remote response time, hours] and [severity 1 on-site response time, hours] per plan, inside [service coverage area] (the name on home and contact-locations). Confirm the phone answer time applies to every caller: the urgent route shows it without a plan condition, here and on contact-proposal and contact-locations.
Severity 2 and 3 clocks (FD-27): [severity 2 reply time, hours], [severity 2 visit time] (svc-service's name), [severity 3 reply time, working days].

Severity definitions (FD-27): svc-service, their home (DR-009, DR-011), now uses this page's wording word for word (form options and table rows, severity 4 included). Confirm one wording for both pages; the form options keep their names so other pages' intents still match.
Call-out and hourly rates without a plan (FD-29): [call-out and hourly rates, CAD], svc-service's name.

Service desk (FD-31): [ticket acknowledgment time, minutes]; whether forms are read out of hours, and [out-of-hours form review time, hours]; [serial number format], and that it is on the nameplate; [trend window, hours]; [parts email address] (contact-locations uses it too) and who receives parts orders.

Reply times (FD-31): [maintenance booking reply time, working days], one time for maintenance and calibration unless you set two; [requalification support reply time, working days]; [other-builder request reply time, working days]; [parts quote turnaround, working hours].

Other builders' systems (FD-30): [makes and equipment types serviced], one name on every page that offers it (DR-011); whether parts are supplied for other makes; whether WFI stills, pure steam generators or stainless loops by others are excluded (the form lists PW systems only). If none are served, the other-builder option, branch, row and help lines go; the headline names no maker. Also whether a fault on another builder's system runs on the severity clocks as a call-out or starts with a condition survey: the table's last row, "First service, other make", times only that request (buyer panel 2026-10-31).

Ozone and UV (FD-16, FD-30): the calibration list and the hero figure show UV only. UV stays if the package has it ([UV, standard or option], sys-storage's name) or FD-30 covers other makes with UV; ozone sensor calibration returns only if FD-30 covers other makers' ozone systems (DR-013).

Certificates shipped with wetted PP and PVC spare parts (FD-17); sys-pw names them [PP material certificates]. The form's option names no material, so it fits any builder's system; the elastomer option names no standard ([elastomer certificates per compound] is cmp-quality's name for what ships; FD-17).
Uploads and privacy (FD-39): [maximum upload size, MB], as on contact-proposal; [privacy notice link], contact-proposal's name, covering PIPEDA and Quebec Law 25 after counsel's check (OQ-81).

Language for the reply (FD-36, DR-012): the field (English, French) returns to step 3 only once a named French-speaking technician or engineer replies within the same times, as on contact-proposal (DR-012 rule 2 and consequences).

Contact routes: [proposal response time, working days] (FD-01), as on contact-proposal; the coverage route's written answer is contact-locations' closing, which uses the same time. Shop visits stay on contact-locations, offered once the shop and test bay are ready (FD-44, DR-004).
